title: Book One · Chapter 70: Bo at the Low Hill
story:
Bo wants to ride up the low hill near the field.

His father brought him there on a free afternoon. Mum and Ronan have a basket for a woman. Her home is beyond the field. The paths meet by a large stone.

“Watch me,” Bo says.

The red bicycle moves up the hill. It slows. Bo pushes harder, then puts one foot down.

“You stopped,” Ronan says.

“I know.”

“I used to go up that.”

Mr Han looks at him. Mum shifts the basket in her hand.

Bo pushes the bicycle back to the stone.

“Then show me.”

Ronan looks at the seat. He wanted a turn for a long time. Now everyone is watching. He feels unsure.

Mr Han checks the path. It is clear. Mum says, “You may have one turn if you want.” The bicycle belongs to Bo. Bo offered Ronan a turn.

Ronan takes the handles. Ronan knows the shape of the handles. But he has not held them for months. He moves forward slowly. The seat is a little lower than he remembers.

At the foot of the hill he pushes hard. Halfway up, the bicycle slows.

He pushes harder still.

His foot comes down beside some grass.

Bo says nothing.

Ronan stands over the bicycle. His face feels hot. He could say the seat is wrong. He could say the hill used to be lower.

“I cannot get up today,” he says.

Bo comes to help him turn.

“I cannot either.”

They push the bicycle down together. Mr Han walks beside them. “Can you reach that white stone?” he asks. “Try that first, before the top.”

“I stopped at that stone,” Ronan says.

“Then we know you can reach it.”

Bo tries first. This time he does not rush at the hill. He reaches the white stone and stops with both feet down. Ronan takes his turn. He gets a little beyond it, but the front wheel turns sideways.

He stops at once.

“Straight first,” Mr Han says. “Distance after.”

Ronan returns the bicycle. His hands are warm. On his short ride, he felt happy, then cross. Now he is tired.

Bo offers another turn. Ronan shakes his head.

“Mum has the basket.”

“I can wait,” she says.

“I know. But I had my turn.”

Bo rides on the flat path while Ronan sits on the stone. The black cloth on the handle jumps in the wind.

Bo stops by the stone. He asks Ronan to hold the bicycle. He needs to tighten the black cloth. Ronan holds it by the seat. Bo pulls one end and ties it shorter. He checks the cloth near the wheel. It cannot catch there now.

“Too long before,” he says.

Ronan did not notice the long cloth before. He looks at the new little knot. Bo knows about this cloth. The cloth is new to Ronan. Ronan knew the old bike very well. He looks at the short knot again.

“You are better on the flat part,” Ronan calls.

“So are you.”

At the far side of the field, Mum stops to rest the basket on a wall. Ronan takes one handle.

“Was that all right?” she asks.

“The bicycle is different.”

“What is different?”

He thinks. “The seat. And Bo is on it more.”

Mum waits.

“I want a bicycle again. I want my own bike.”

“We can look for a way to buy one.”

She does not promise a day. Ronan holds his end of the basket and helps lift it from the wall. Behind them, Bo rides without a bell. There is still no bell on the red bicycle. Ronan's bell is at home.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- halfway＝半路
- a turn＝一次轮流
- distance＝距离
- the flat part＝平坦处

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：seat＝车座；knot＝结；handle＝把手。

## 读句提示

**I want my own bike.**

我／想要／我自己的自行车。不是把one that…接在上一句后。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan亲自骑上坡后发现了什么？
2. 他最后向Mum说出了怎样的愿望？
